reader_warning: This template records the shape of a readiness packet for a future human authorization decision. It is NOT a grant. It MUST NOT be passed as item9.calibration-authorization/1.0.0. Live filled packets stay under .local/ and must keep fitting_allowed=false.
not_observed_policy: If the implementation does not already compute a fingerprint or version, record NOT_OBSERVED rather than hashing ad hoc.
live_packet_location_policy: OPERATOR_LOCAL_ONLY — do not commit live fingerprints as authority
notes: ABSENT authorization does not block CALIBRATION_PREFLIGHT_READY.
A packet is never an authorization grant.
